summary: Verified RSS feed artwork + show notes auto-import, per-episode sync, manual-edit protection, image content-type sniffing, and Episode Series panel UI. Ran 11 pytest tests (all PASSED) plus Playwright UI check against real data. Real data preserved: 118 rss_items (2 imported), gemini_api_key length 53, both imported episodes retain feed artwork (provider='rss') + show notes.

minor.issue: Deleting a series only sets plan_items.series_id=None but leaves orphan plan_items that have no date/episode purpose. Consider deleting empty orphan plan_items (ones with series_id=null AND episode_id set but no scheduled date) or at least cleaning plan_items created purely by series add-episodes.

When ep.assets.source == 'rss', re-syncing re-writes show_notes/description fields with the latest feed values and marks updated_at/updated_by anew. Idempotent in outcome but churns metadata every call (show_notes counter returned 2 on second call even though content was identical). Minor — consider short-circuiting if content is unchanged.

critical_code_review_comments: rss_import.sync_episode_from_feed correctly skips artwork when source_url matches an existing image, and only writes show_notes when assets missing or source=='rss' — behaves per spec.
extras._sniff reads only first 12 bytes and FileResponse serves correct content-type — verified via /api/episodes/{id}/artwork/{id}.png returning image/png for a real PNG write.
extras.save_assets (PUT /episodes/{id}/assets) correctly stamps source='manual' which guards against overwrite — verified end-to-end.
FeedSyncButton hides itself when !episode.rss_guid or user role != admin (verified in code; producer 403 verified via API).
EpisodeSeries panel wires series + membership from two endpoints — a single combined endpoint could reduce round trips (minor perf).

pytest.ini still forces -n 2 --dist loadscope; conftest snapshot/restore is per-controller which is only correct when xdist is disabled (-n 0). This remains a landmine for future suites that write real settings — flagged by iteration_5 as well.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (sync panel, feed-sync buttons, series panel + dialog all render & function)

rca_of_the_issue: N/A — feature validation, no bugs found. All contract requirements of the review request are met: (1) sync-imported idempotent for artwork, (2) manual edits preserved against RSS re-sync (source='manual' blocks overwrite), (3) producer role 403, (4) non-rss episode 400, (5) /api/episodes/{id}/artwork/{id}.png correctly content-sniffs to image/png, (6) feed-sync buttons and episode-series-panel render with correct data-testids on the episode page.
